title: HSK1 Gate 1 · Xia Dynasty
explanationEn: Gate 1: Xia Dynasty. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第1关：夏朝。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 很久以前，中国发了大水。大水进了田里，也进了很多人的家。人们没有地方住，只能住到山上去。大禹是一个好人，王请他去治水。
passageEn: Long ago, a great flood came to China. The flood went into the fields, and into many people's homes. People had nowhere to live, and could only go up the mountains to live. Dayu was a good man, so the king asked him to go and control the flood.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: Long ago, a great flood came to China.
comprehension.answer: 很久以前，中国发了大水。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？
comprehension.answerEn: People had nowhere to live, and could only go up the mountains to live.
comprehension.answer: 人们没有地方住，只能住到山上去。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 中国 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“中国”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 中国 (Zhōngguó) means "China" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “中国”（Zhōngguó）的意思是“China”，就在上面的短文里。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 进 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“进”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 进 (jìn) means "to go into" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “进”（jìn）的意思是“to go into”，就在上面的短文里。

check.zh: 很久以前，中国发了大水。

options.text: The bones were big and white, and many characters could be carved on them.
Long ago, a great flood came to China.
Long ago, China had a dynasty called the Shang.
At that time there was no paper yet, so people carved characters on bones.

check.explanationEn: "很久以前，中国发了大水。" means "Long ago, a great flood came to China.".
check.explanation: “很久以前，中国发了大水。”的意思是“Long ago, a great flood came to China.”。

speakingPromptEn: Tell a grown-up about Xia Dynasty in two or three short Chinese sentences. Use words from the list above.
speakingPrompt: 用上面的词，跟家里的大人说两三句中文，说一说夏朝。
